exposure: COVID-19 positive vs. normal pregnant women
cohort: 65 pregnant women with COVID-19 and 66 normal pregnant women and their newborns
finding: While COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was associated with some differences in blood parameters and a higher likelihood of cesarean delivery, it did not appear to increase the risk of hearing impairment in newborns.
mod_finding: The normal delivery rate in patients with COVID-19 was found to be statistically significantly higher than the cesarean section delivery status.
